title: Concept: Strict-Transport-Security delivered over plaintext HTTP
description: The Strict-Transport-Security header arrived on a response fetched over plaintext HTTP. Browsers only accept HSTS from a secure transport, so the policy is discarded, the connection stays downgradable, and the presence of the header gives reviewers a false assurance that the policy is installed.
applicability: Responses fetched over http:// that carry Strict-Transport-Security.
risk: HSTS is never installed despite the header being present; MEDIUM severity because the downgrade path stays open on every plaintext visit.
